text:
oliver: Uploaded airgap bundle v2.7.1-stable to staging-artifacts.s3 and pushed images to our private registry. ready for preflight checks?

sophie: grabbing the bundle now, will run checksum + cosign verify. estimated 15m.

maya: planning a staggered canary: 3 customers in eu-west, 2 in us-east for 2h windows. keep rollback hooks ready.

deploy-bot: [deploy-scheduler] Canary rollout scheduled: start=2026-05-02T10:00Z window=2h targets=eu-west(3),us-east(2) artifact=airgap-v2.7.1-stable

ryan: quick pin note — the onprem installer manifest is pinned to image tag `redwood/inference:2.7.1-stable-20260502`. do not change tag after sign-off.

kevin: QA smoke results: startup ok on k8s v1.25 job, kv-cache warm, basic generate and embed flows pass. saw a minor warn from exporter but not critical. :white_check_mark:

qa-bot: preflight checks: sha256 matches, cosign signatures valid, manifest schema OK. report: https://ci.redwood/system/reports/1779994321/preflight

oliver: Logging release notes snippet here for the delivery package so infra can include it in the customer brief
oliver: - v2.7.1: Airgap installer: fix KV cache leak on large-seq workloads, improved batching heuristics; updated compilation kernels for A100/4x16.

maya: rollback thresholds proposed: p95 latency increase > 200ms OR error-rate > 5% for 15m sliding window. manual rollback if any cert/key mismatch during deploy.

ryan: noted. Also add automatic fallback route to hosted-compatible model if canary crosses thresholds (policy id: fallback-low-tier-2026).

kevin: cosign step I ran: `cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood-kms/projects/release-key redwood/inference:2.7.1-stable` -> success. I also did `sha256sum airgap-v2.7.1.tar.gz` and uploaded the checksum to the signed-manifests bucket.

oliver: ops checklist for cutover:
- push signed manifest to delivery bucket
- publish customer-facing release notes (short)
- schedule inbound support stanby (oncall + eng-releases)
- start canary per deploy-bot

oliver: commands for delivery ops (paste into installer host):
```
# verify bundle
sha256sum -c airgap-v2.7.1.tar.gz.sha256
# verify cosign signature
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood-kms/projects/release-key airgap-v2.7.1.tar.gz
```

oncall: i'm on standby for the 10:00Z window. will watch p95 and error dashboards and ping here if anything looks off.

maya: minor note — our canary uses reduced qps (30% of normal) and sticky routing so we see steady-state. if everything green at 90m we expand to full.

sophie: documenting delivery artifacts for compliance: bundle sha, cosign sig, installer image tag, manifest id, and the KMS key id. adding to release binder now.

oliver: decision on rollback flow: first automated soft-fallback -> if unresolved 10m after fallback then manual rollback and revoke manifest from delivery bucket. all agreed?

ryan: agree. add a comms step: notify customer success + affected customers via the scheduled delivery email template before manual rollback.

kevin: one more: include note for customers who run airgap verify: `./installer --verify-only` before applying. reduces bad state rollouts.

deploy-bot: [deploy-runner] Canary started for airgap-v2.7.1-stable at 2026-05-02T10:00Z (initiated by oliver). monitoring hooks active.

oliver: thanks all — keep updates short in thread. will post final go/no-go at +30m. :eyes:
